Settle into a booth, catch the race on the big screen, or sprawl out on the couch with your dog. Grumpy Goat Grinds is built for hanging out — because the best part of the ride is the stories after.

Grumpy Goat started the way most good things do — with a passion for riding and a need for good coffee. What began as a small bike shop in Willard has grown into a community hub where cyclists, skiers, paddlers, and neighbors come together.
We believe a great ride deserves a great cup of coffee afterward. And a well-tuned bike makes every ride better. So we put both under one roof, added a couch, turned on the race, and opened the door.
The name? Well, mountain goats are stubborn, sure-footed, and thrive where others won’t go. Sound like anyone you know on the trail?
